findings.title: Job relocated without proof in-place import check fails
findings.problem: The spec decision is to rework in place under src/codemie/enterprise/sync/, with a top-level package only as a fallback if the import check cannot pass there. The diff renames the package to src/idp_sync_job/ and shows no evidence the in-place check failed.
findings.impact: Deviates from an approved spec decision; docs, Dockerfile and tests all hard-code the new path.
findings.recommendation: Show the import check failing in place and record that decision, or move the job back to the specified path.

disposition.rationale: Left as is by the requester. The move to the top-level package src/idp_sync_job/ is justified: in a clean interpreter, importing codemie.enterprise.sync pulls in 262 codemie modules, because src/codemie/enterprise/__init__.py eagerly imports loader, langfuse, litellm, plugin, mcp_auth and idp. The spec allowed the top-level fallback exactly when the in-place import check fails, and the requester approved it for that case (AR-7).

findings.title: Dry run omits planned deactivation count vs ceiling
findings.problem: SyncCoordinator._apply logs one 'dry_run: would deactivate' line per user and a deactivated= counter, but never compares the planned count with SYNC_DEACTIVATE_MAX_RATIO or the active-user total. docs/operations/idp-managed-sync.md says it does.
findings.impact: A required spec criterion is only partly met; operators relying on the dry run cannot see how close a deactivation plan is to the ceiling before going live.
findings.recommendation: Log planned deactivations, active-user total and the ratio against the ceiling during dry run, and keep the docs consistent.
findings.check_notes: coordinator logs planned/active/ratio vs SYNC_DEACTIVATE_MAX_RATIO in dry run; docs updated; test added

fix.change: dry run logs planned deactivations, active total, ratio and SYNC_DEACTIVATE_MAX_RATIO; docs updated

findings.title: Truncated Keycloak list returned as complete
findings.problem: In _get_all, when a later page (page_number > 0) is not a list, `return items if page_number else None` returns the partial list as if complete, contradicting the docstring that a cut-short read is never mistaken for the whole list.
findings.impact: Admin-role members and group members come from this path, so a truncated read can demote admins or strip memberships. Reachability confirmed in source: the callers use the result directly without marking the snapshot incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Raise _ReadError when a later page is not a list so callers mark the snapshot incomplete and skip those changes.
findings.check_notes: _get_all raises _ReadError on non-list later page; test added

fix.change: _get_all raises _ReadError when a later page is not a list

findings.title: Non-Keycloak accounts become deactivation targets
findings.problem: plan_deactivations targets every active platform user absent from the enabled-Keycloak snapshot, including the sync service account, local accounts and the bootstrap admin (Keycloak /users usually omits service accounts). Nothing excludes them.
findings.impact: They consume the max-ratio budget and rely entirely on API 409 refusals each run; if the API does not refuse one, it is deactivated. Whether the API refuses all of them was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Exclude the sync service account and SYNC_ADMIN_USER_ID from targets and from the ratio denominator.
findings.check_notes: deactivation_candidates excludes admin and service account, used for targets and ratio denominator; test added

fix.change: deactivation candidates exclude SYNC_ADMIN_USER_ID and service-account-<client id>, also from the ratio denominator

findings.title: SYNC_DRY_RUN typo silently enables live writes
findings.problem: _flag returns True only for {1,true,yes,on}; any other non-empty value (e.g. 'ture', 'enabled', 'Y') is False, so the dry-run switch fails open.
findings.impact: An operator intending a dry run performs live platform writes, including user changes and deactivations.
findings.recommendation: Raise ValueError when a non-empty value is not a recognised true/false token.
findings.check_notes: _flag raises ValueError on unrecognised tokens; tests added

fix.change: _flag raises ValueError on unrecognised boolean tokens

findings.title: Numeric settings have no range validation
findings.problem: from_env parses SYNC_BATCH_SIZE, SYNC_MAX_PAGES, SYNC_DEACTIVATE_MIN_USERS and SYNC_DEACTIVATE_MAX_RATIO with no bounds. The old coordinator rejected batch_size < 1 and had a test; both were removed while chart and docs still say 'minimum 1'. float() also accepts nan/inf.
findings.impact: Batch size 0 never satisfies len(page) < batch, so the same /users request repeats up to the page ceiling; nan, negative or percent-style ratios silently disable or invert the mass-deactivation ceiling. No test fails if the guard is absent.
findings.recommendation: Reject batch_size < 1, max_pages < 1, min_users < 0 and a ratio outside 0..1 or nan; add tests for 0 and -5.
findings.check_notes: Settings._validate rejects out-of-range batch, pages, min users, ratio, nan/inf; tests added

fix.change: Settings validates batch_size, max_pages, min_users, ratio range and nan
